comparison.objective: Disengage a service cover from hidden tabs and remove it, versus tune and lock a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Constrained sliding to release hidden retainers followed by lifting versus recessed-tool insertion, fine rotary adjustment, counterholding, and tightening.
comparison.success_condition: Cover released and lifted without tab damage versus two safe impact cycles and a drift-resistant locked setting.
comparison.reason: Retainer release/removal does not test dynamic damping commissioning. Body and specs are absent, so tab travel and damage thresholds are missing.
